input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, exclusion of damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere: searches for "liability" return only the No Joint Venture provision (p0061-p0062), and there is no "damages" or indemnification language at all. The Warranties article (Section 9, p0055-p0058) and the General Provisions (Section 10) are silent on liability caps. Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct and consequential liability, which fails even the fallback (mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs). We inserted a new Section 10.9 in the General Provisions (which survive under Section 10.7) setting a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000, a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirming that the Company's payment obligations under Sections 3 and 4.2 are not capped damages.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual limitation of liability clause with standard uncapped carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited and consequential damages; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our standard position. Confidentiality, indemnity, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Section 8 or of its data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligations to pay amounts due under Sections 3 and 4.2 are not subject to this Section 10.9.
